name: Lime
source:
Catgirl who came to repay the protagonist's altruism, no. 2.

At first glance, she gives the impression of a relaxed & cool-headed individual, but in actuality, she is quite a mischievous and difficult little thing to deal with. That said, she'll only pull pranks on people she cares about; one could say, she has a heart of gold.

Being heavily interested in the protagonist, she takes great delight in teasing him.

Mikan & Lemon are like family to her, and she's rather like the head of the pack.

"You're a real cutie, Master... Teehee, just kidding."
